benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status: 25% bonus points on paid stays, late checkout, a welcome gift via points, and room upgrades when available.
benefits.terms: Automatic for cardholders by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account. 15 Elite Night Credits awarded each calendar year toward the next elite tier.

benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free Night Award granted every year after card renewal, usable at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points.
benefits.terms: Awarded automatically each year after card renewal, no spend requirement.

benefits.name: $60K Spend Free Night Award
benefits.description: Additional Free Night Award earned after spending $60,000 on eligible purchases in a calendar year, usable at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points.
benefits.terms: Requires $60,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Business Card Member Rate Discount
benefits.description: 7% discount off standard room rates when booking the Amex Business Card Member Rate at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
benefits.terms: Must book the specific Card Member Rate to receive the discount.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage to or theft of most rental vehicles.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on baggage while traveling on a common carrier.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, wireless telephone services purchased directly from U.S. service providers, and U.S. purchases for shipping.
